work.summary: HISTORICAL FIXTURE (not a statement about current herdr behavior). Delivery pilot: a prompt sent to a busy worker with a short --wait timed out, yet the worker kept running, finished its current turn and answered the queued prompt without retry. No work-system task; project-level report.

branch.reason: pilot ran in scratch directories outside the repository

model.reason: historical reconstruction; authoring model not preserved

usage.completeness_reason: the pilot used no plugin skills; only raw herdr CLI calls

outcome.intended: Learn whether a timed-out send means the prompt was lost.
outcome.achieved: Showed a timeout is delivery-unverified: the prompt was processed later.

tooling.reason: herdr exposed state; only the timeout was ambiguous

worked_well.observation: Attributed result markers made the late delivery provable without a retry.

items.change: Model delivery-unverified as its own run state and never auto-resend on timeout.
items.observation: The timed-out prompt was answered later without any retry.
items.expected_benefit: Avoids duplicate dispatch to a worker that is still running.

uncertainty.note: one case per harness, no load or restart test

ambiguous_states.observed: --wait --timeout 25000 timed out after 25 s while the recipient was busy.
ambiguous_states.resolution: Recipient finished the running turn and answered the queued prompt with the expected marker; no retry was sent.
